name: Saudi Marketing Company
summary: Headquartered in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, Saudi Marketing Company was established in 1978. The company operates across Saudi Arabia, specializing in retail, trading, and importing, with a primary focus on foodstuffs and consumer goods. Its business is structured into three segments: Retail, Household, and Entertainment Service. The company manages its retail outlets under the Farm Superstores brand, overseeing a substantial network that includes 90 main branches and 17 mini-markets serving residential complexes. Furthermore, Saudi Marketing Company diversifies its services by operating children's play areas.
